methodology: Sequential in-process calls (no HTTP layer), 200 search requests cycling 12 evaluation queries after 20 warm-up requests; answers cycle 2 security questions. Indexing delay = canonical MongoDB write until the chunk is countable in OpenSearch via the running worker. Single client, no concurrency: these are latency measurements, not throughput or capacity results.

environment.topology: single-node MongoDB replica set, single OpenSearch node, single Kafka broker (Docker Desktop, WSL 2)

indexing_delay.note: Includes the 1 s OpenSearch refresh interval and 50 ms polling granularity.
